prompt:
Schedule five jobs. Each job runs without interruption from its integer start time for its duration.
Jobs (duration, resource demand): A (2, 2), B (3, 1), C (2, 2), D (1, 1), E (2, 1).
Constraints: (1) A must finish before C starts; (2) B must finish before E starts; (3) B and D must not run at the same time; (4) at every time, the total demand of running jobs must not exceed 3; (5) every job must finish by time 6; (6) start times are integers >= 0.
Give the final schedule as a JSON object mapping each job letter to its start time, in a ```json code block.
